business_problem: Blackroll needed one cloud environment where commerce, wearable, and app data could be unified to power personalized recovery coaching while also accelerating software delivery for a lean digital team.
solution_summary: Blackroll uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Blackroll needed one cloud environment where commerce, wearable, and app data could be unified to power personalized recovery coaching while also accelerating software delivery for a lean digital team. BigQuery builds a unified view of ecommerce records and mobile app events to inform recovery experiences, serving as the storage layer. Cloud SQL pulls daily wearable data such as sleep patterns and activity loads into the platform, serving as the storage layer. Cloud Run powers the headless platform services and the Antigravity orchestration runtime used to speed software development, serving as the serving layer. Firestore supports the digital ecosystem’s headless application architecture, serving as the storage layer. Gemini powers the AI recovery coach and other automated tools used across the platform, serving as the compute layer.
